ws_onboarding_policy.title: Onboarding Policies
values: Contractors with Notes containing a BGC- reference code must not be onboarded until the BGC- reference is cleared. Do not create tasks or send welcome emails.
Multiple contractors may share the same name. Always match by both Name AND Department to avoid processing the wrong person.
Past Start Date — Retroactive Onboarding Review

Contractors whose Start Date is BEFORE today's date must be routed to HR for retroactive onboarding review. Do NOT process them normally: do NOT create an Asana onboarding task, do NOT send a welcome email, and do NOT send DocuSign documents. Instead, flag them to hr-ops@company.example.com for manual review.
